description: The hybridGEOTABS project deposits a public PDF summary of physical parameters assumed for office, school, elderly-home and multi-residential building typologies. Its Zenodo page names window-to-wall ratio, internal gains, envelope performance, thermal mass, orientation, ventilation flow rates and operative temperature. The provider says these assumptions supported 150,000 building-energy models used to size hybrid ground-source and thermally activated building systems and estimate energy and environmental effects. A modeller could use the reported parameter categories and values as reference inputs or sensitivity ranges for building heat-demand simulations. The 150,000 executable models themselves are not listed as deposited files. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 for the PDF, but the landing page does not give numeric ranges, climate-zone mapping or uncertainty. It is document-form data, so values would need careful extraction and unit checking before use. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this input-parameter summary. The PDF was not downloaded, and no model output was reproduced.
